question: After excluding every tested #524 Dusk shatter target and every closed #525/#421 family before reading support, does the one remaining authored Dusk-specific mechanism, Shatterer's Crown threshold setup, have enough frozen policy-selection and current-main route capacity to justify an identity-safe boss-offer preflight?
retrospectiveScope: This is a zero-new-row source-and-policy decision-value screen. It selects the mechanism from immutable authored source structure before reading support, then uses only frozen policy relic scores, boss reach and Shatter occurrence from an already complete current-main cache. It does not estimate a causal Crown effect, alter an offer, admit a package, tune a score, rerun #524/#525 or support a detector or product claim.

sourceFilter.selectionRule: Keep only immutable graph edges with aspectScope duskblade and a runtime mediator not represented by a closed family. Exclude exact targets from the tested #524 dusk-shatter-relics package. Collapse all remaining attack-card source aliases when the target changes the shared Dusk Shatter threshold rather than one card payoff.
sourceFilter.result: The filter leaves one target family before support counts: relic:shatterersCrown.

candidate.mediator: Dusk-only facet chips reaching the reduced facet threshold and producing Shatter
candidate.setup: At combat start the existing relic reduces every enemy facet_max by one and grants each enemy one Fervor.
candidate.sourceAlias: All 26 authored attack-card sources are one shared Dusk Shatter producer family; no source card is selected or tuned.

definition.name: Shatterer's Crown
definition.text: Enemy glass runs thin: all facet gauges are 1 smaller. Enemies begin with 1 Fervor.

candidate.claimBoundary: The screen can authorise only an identity-safe research knob that guarantees the existing relic is included in an otherwise unchanged boss offer. It cannot authorise ownership, a score bonus, a content change or package admission.

mechanismAssertions: CombatRules applies facet chips only when run.aspect is Duskblade.
Shatterer's Crown is an existing unlocked boss-pool relic with a benefit and an enemy-Fervor cost.
BalancePilot gives the existing relic a Dusk-specific score bonus and chooses the maximum integer relic score from the offered set.

cohort.role: Necessary decision-value screen only; any authorised offer knob requires exact null identity and a new preregistered causal experiment.

counterfactualDefinition.offer: Shatterer's Crown plus an unordered pair from the other four current boss relics; all six pairs are enumerated without simulation.
counterfactualDefinition.score: Exactly int(policy.relics[id] plus policy.relicDuskBonus for Shatterer's Crown), matching the frozen BalancePilot comparison.
counterfactualDefinition.strictPairWin: Crown score is strictly greater than both co-offered relic scores. Ties never count as evidence because live choice depends on offer order.
counterfactualDefinition.robustSelector: Strictly selects Crown for all six possible co-offer pairs.
counterfactualDefinition.robustDecliner: Strictly selects Crown for none of the six possible co-offer pairs.
counterfactualDefinition.projectedActive: A robust selector that reached at least one boss boundary and produced at least one Shatter on the frozen current-main rectangle.
counterfactualDefinition.claimBoundary: This is a deterministic policy-capacity calculation, not a causal trajectory or outcome estimate.

estimands.sourceUniqueness: Exact number of immutable Dusk graph edges, mediators, excluded tested targets, eligible target families and collapsed source aliases.
estimands.currentMainSupport: Policy counts for current Crown acquisition, Crown-plus-Shatter activation, boss-boundary reach and any Shatter.
estimands.offerDecisionValue: Counts of robust selectors, robust decliners, context-dependent policies, projected-active policies and the exact six-pair win histogram.
estimands.outcomes: No win, duration or package-effect endpoint is used.

gates.provenance: The 16/16 policy-sensitivity minimum is the exact 64-policy first-look gate. Boss reach and Shatter capacity must each support at least that active minimum before an offer knob can have decision value.

decisionRules.success: The source filter leaves exactly Shatterer's Crown and the frozen policies include at least 16 robust selectors, 16 robust decliners, 16 projected-active, 16 boss-reachable and 16 Shatter-capable identities.
decisionRules.futility: The source filter is valid but any policy-selection, projected-activation, boss-reach or Shatter-capacity gate fails.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable blob, exact source hash, mechanism definition, boss pool, graph alias, current-main output, policy identity, ledger identity, numeric input or wall-time assertion fails.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze only dusk-shatter-threshold-crown for an identity-safe research-only boss-offer inclusion knob preflight. Before any simulator row prove exact null policy, path, RNG and result identity and prove non-null changes only the registered boss-offer mediator. Do not force ownership, tune scores or claim package admission.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the existing Shatterer's Crown offer-inclusion mechanism and author the smallest new deterministic Duskblade mediator justified by the measured source and capacity bottleneck. Do not search another existing scalar, Ward, Kindle, Afterimage or tested #524 package.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record no decision and run no simulator row until the immutable evidence or identity fault is resolved.

methodBoundary: No ML, RL, optimiser, simulator, candidate ranking or outcome-based selection is authorised. The only candidate is selected by an exact source filter before support counts.
